rights.fileTitle: File:Proportion of the world population living in a country where homosexual acts are not criminalized, 1760-2020.jpg

photo.fileTitle: File:Proportion of the world population living in a country where homosexual acts are not criminalized, 1760-2020.jpg
photo.caption: Proportion of the world population living in a country where homosexual acts are not criminalized, 1760–2020
photo.description: "Note : As of January 1, 2020, 79% of the world’s population lives in a country that does not criminalize homosexual acts, compared to 63% in 2000, 20% in 1900, 16% in 1800 and 11% in 1760. Sources : Carroll and Mendos, 2017 ; Mendos, 2019 ; Gapminder, 2019 ; Maddison, 2003 ; United Nations, 2017a ; complementary sources above."

photo.fileTitle: File:Decriminalization of homosexuality by country or territory (remastered).svg
photo.caption: Criminalized Decriminalized 1791–1850 Decriminalized 1850–1945 Decriminalized 1946–1989 Decriminalized 1990–present Unknown date of legalization Never criminalized
photo.description: This map is similar to File:Decriminalization of Homosexuality by country or territory.svg but with a simplified color scheme: Never (gray), Before 1850 (blue), 1850–1945 (green), 1946-1990 (yellow), 1990–present (orange), still criminalized (red). These years are not arbitrary: 1850 (after the Napoleonic decriminalizations), 1945 (end of World War II), 1990 (fall of the eastern bloc, which triggered decriminalization in several countries). Data based on ILGA's December 2020 report
